title: The Canopy Where the Dream Breaks Into Leaves

features.name: the-light-separator
features.desc-on-touch: light filters through woven leaves, each beam carrying a different moment of waking. You watch the beams separate then rejoin.

features.name: the-branch-notation
features.desc-on-touch: bark holds writing that the canopy itself is composing, notation for growth that changes as you watch it. The script is learning its own grammar.

features.name: the-dreaming-sprite
features.desc-on-touch: a creature mid-transformation: leaf-shaped, breathing like an animal, hovering between sleep and flight. You cannot tell if it is becoming or already is.

features.name: the-leaf-counts
features.desc-on-touch: a standing directory: each leaf indexed and filed, dream-weights recorded in the margin. The numbering system learns as it counts.

features.name: the-amber-hollow
features.desc-on-touch: stacked sleep-cavities carved deep into a tower of old resin, each one warm to the touch. The hollow breathes with a dreaming rhythm.

inscription: the canopy teaches you the same dream you brought with you

file.name: Dream_Cascade_Threshold_031.tmp
file.note: a recording growing physical: breath becoming leaf-sound, sleep-weights registering on bark. Corrupted timestamp marks the exact moment dreaming touched form.

exits.label: back down through the orchard-thought that bore you here
into deeper canopy where names dissolve into sound
toward branches where the dream learned to breathe with lungs
back to half-restored spaces where the diagnostic still mends itself
